desc.zh: 前往目的地，安抚并劝诫许褚。
desc.en: Head to the destination to console and counsel Xu Chu.

story.zh: 邺城已破，冀州唾手可得，然而曹军中的两名功臣却在胜利前夕争的不可开交...
story.en: Ye has fallen, and Ji Province is within easy grasp, yet on the eve of triumph, two meritorious officers in Cao Cao's army are locked in a bitter feud...

forbidden.zh: 主角为曹操，许褚，许攸时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Xu Chu, or Xu You.

participate.zh: 【身属曹操势力】、【许褚与许攸为曹操势力武将】、【曹操占领邺城】且【曹操势力至少有8名武将】
participate.en: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Xu Chu and Xu You are Officers in Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Cao Cao occupies Ye】, and 【Cao Cao's Faction has at least 8 Officers】

defy.zh: 【<与许攸的关系等级达到2级> 救下许攸，使其成为家将】
defy.en: 【<Relationship level with Xu You reaches Level 2> Rescue Xu You and recruit him as a Retainer】

conditions.zh: 玩家势力 = 曹操 或 曹操：NPC势力已签订信义契约 = 是
conditions.en: Player's faction = Cao Cao or Cao Cao: the player belongs to their faction = yes
Cao Cao is not the player
Xu Chu is not the player
Xu You is not the player

force.zh: 曹操身为君主并占领<邺>
force.en: Cao Cao is Ruler and occupies <Ye>

force.zh: 许褚、许攸加入曹操势力
force.en: Xu Chu and Xu You join Cao Cao's Faction
